contract_answer.question: Does the NA-E006 configuration (NaFadeNet + gated fade extrapolation) also improve on the parent NaFadeNet on paper split 42?
contract_answer.conclusion: Independently recomputed from all 600 saved predictions: selected-checkpoint MAPE 0.181909, RMSE 52.300 cycles, and Acc@15 0.450 versus parent NA-E004 at 0.206247, 58.058, and 0.383. MAPE improves in every prefix band by 0.0183 to 0.0343. Prediction spread remains compressed at 0.4846 of target spread and mean bias is -25.922 cycles.

main_symptom: The split-42 confirmation improves MAPE by 0.024338 versus NA-E004, but predictions remain compressed; cells 1-8-57 and 5-3-37 still have the largest cell-balanced MAPEs at 0.3060 and 0.2810.

contradicting_evidence: A fixed-g control is absent, so the gain cannot yet be assigned specifically to learned gate adaptation.
Prediction-to-target spread remains strongly compressed at 0.4846.
causes.interpretation: Adding the extrapolation path is the supported source of the matched gain: all five prefix bands improve, overall relative bias changes from -0.07137 to -0.06563, and the largest cell gains are 5-3-37 (0.35013 to 0.28103) and 5-8-32 (0.28009 to 0.23333).
missing_evidence: Saved per-sample gate outputs by prefix band.

contradicting_evidence: The gate is connected and HEALTHY: median grad/parameter ratio 0.001544, median update ratio 0.0001017, and no non-finite gradients.
The output-layer weights and bias did move away from initialization.
causes.interpretation: After 195 steps the checkpoint remains close to the initial blend: ext_scale=2.002642, ext_shift=-3.601485, gate output bias=-1.995332, and maximum absolute output weight=0.005405. This supports a learning-speed repair but does not prove an exactly constant gate without saved gate values.
missing_evidence: A matched reparameterization changing only effective gate/calibration step size.
Direct gate-output summaries on validation samples.

contradicting_evidence: The selected epoch-8 checkpoint improves all three headline metrics over the matched parent.
Gradient health is HEALTHY and padding output change is zero.
causes.interpretation: After selection, train loss falls from 0.011068 at epoch 8 to 0.009038 at epoch 13 while validation MAPE rises from 0.181909 to 0.194304. Checkpoint restoration preserves the gain, but the six-cell split remains noisy.
missing_evidence: A matched fixed-g control across all three paper splits.
